review.notes: The initial candidate is retained as rejected because pose2 left six pixels of top margin. The accepted revision has fifteen unique complete drawings in 5x3 row-major order, no bodies touch the canvas, and all hands/feet/hair remain in-bounds. Juniper retains her compact human build, warm light skin, dark eyes, dark-purple high ponytail and gold tie, blank Condas kit, dark knee pads and purple/gold shoes. No basketball or rim is drawn. Reviewed on white and black grounds.
